More EV Makers Choose NVIDIA DRIVEfor Automated Driving
：Li Auto,a pioneer in extended-range EVs, has selected NVIDIA DRIVE Thor to power its next-generation fleets

GWM (Great Wall Motor), among China's leading new energy vehicle makers, has announced its upcoming EVs will integrate DRiVE Orin for intelligent assisted-driving; first model with the system debuts in 1H 2024

NVIDIA Drive Thor
NVIDIA DRIVE Orin is the Al car computer of choice for today's intelligent fleets
Its successor, NVIDIA DRIVE Thor, offers more Al performance, and integrates a wide range of intelligent capabilities into a single Al compute platform
Delivers autonomous driving and parking, driver and passenger monitoring,and Al cockpit functionality
Singtel, NVIDIA to Bring Sovereign Al to Southeast Asia
Singtel, a leading communications services provider based in Singapore, will bring the NVIDlA Al platform to businesses in the island nation and beyond
The data centers will serve as sovereign national resources - Al factories that process the private datasets of companies, startups,universities and governments safely on shore
Singtel will offer its customers:

NVIDIA Al Enterprise,a software platform for building and deploying Al applications, including generative Al Singtel will also be an NVIDIA Cloud Partner, delivering optimized Al services on the NVIDlA platform
Singtel's first Al services will spin up in Singapore, with future data centers under construction in Indonesia and Thailand
Announcing Equinix Private Al with NVIDIA DGX

Equinix, the world's digital infrastructure company, announced a fully managed private cloud service that enables enterprises to easily acquire and manage their own NVIDIA DGX Al infrastructure for building and running custom gen Al models
Service includes NVIDIA DGX systems, networking and NVIDIA Al Enterprise software platform
Enterprises can own NVIDIA Al supercomputing and software, paired with operational efficiency of Equinix management, in hundreds of data centers worldwide
Turnkey offering hosted and managed by Equinix, designed and deployed by NVIDIA
